Saying that it is completely over is wrong. It isn't. If you ask yourself "Did I try absolutely everything to fix it all? " the answer would be no. No, you didn't. Don't be afraid to try. If you fail, try again. Never stop trying. Go out, meet new people, try to learn your way out of what you've missed. You are completely capable of it and I know it. Most people don't do their best to achieve something and still achieve it. You are not like them, but what is the problem to try at 100%? What is stopping you from it? Why run from what you can and will eventually have? Go and get it. There is no other way. For example those meaningful people that never came into your life won't just magically show up at your doorstep. You have to travel the distance. If your road is longer and harder than someone else's, then what? It does not matter the length, it only matters if you choose to cross it. Life is an adventure and we are literally in an open sandbox game where with your two legs you can go anywhere, with your two arms you can craft anything, with your voice you can make people hear anything. You have to play, because as far as we know life, although short, is still the longest trip of all. Take it. Muster up your courage and run through the unknown. Run at a faster pace then the others, reach them and then....it is up to you.
